en.topic_title: Typhoon Dolphin weakens but disrupts travel in east China
en.topic_summary:
Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain to eastern China on Monday, causing hundreds of flight cancellations even as the storm weakened and some cities resumed public transport.



A resident uses an umbrella to shelter from the rain as they walk on the Bund a day after Typhoon Dolphin made landfall in Shanghai on August 10, 2026. Photo: Hectar Retamal/AFP.
